item.title: PGSimCity - How PostgreSQL Works
item.description:
📝 PGSimCity · How PostgreSQL Works, in 3D PGSimCity A working model of the PostgreSQL engine loading the city code… Early, unreviewed prototype. It almost certainly contains inaccuracies in both the model and explanations. PGSimCity needs JavaScript and WebGL2 to run.
🔗 Read more: https://nikolays.github.io/PGSimCity/

item.title: US citizen charged after GrapheneOS phone wipes during airport search
item.description:
📝 The case raises questions about which constitutional rights apply at US borders, including international airports, where authorities have broader search powers. He said authorities have treated the use of GrapheneOS itself as suspicious. In Catalonia, Spain, police have been profiling people carrying Pixel phones, assuming they have GrapheneOS installed and are drug dealers or gang members.
🔗 Read more: https://www.techspot.com/news/113236-us-prosecutors-charge-atlanta-man-after-grapheneos-phone.html

item.title: Scriptc by Vercel: TypeScript-to-Native compiler, no JavaScript engine in binary
item.description:
📝 scriptc Zero-runtime TypeScript. The standard library — strings with UTF-16-exact semantics, arrays/Maps/Sets with JS-exact ordering and identity, JSON with runtime-validated casts, Math, typed arrays and Buffer, Error hierarchies with typed catch. Servers are tested with live client drivers against both implementations.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/vercel-labs/scriptc
